backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing invoice and payment management with role-based access control, including functions for uploading invoices, entering single/batch payments, managing user profiles, and querying payment history and reports.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features: fixing the invoice selector for multi-retailer batch payments and ensuring batch payment form processes multiple invoices with RTGS payment mode.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components for authentication, payment entry (single and batch), invoice management, reports, and admin features with role-based access controls.
frontend/docs/publish-live.md: Go-live checklist covering pre-deployment verification for authentication, admin/user features, UI/UX, data integrity, browser compatibility, known limitations, and post-deployment smoke tests.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components including sidebar, charts, and semantic tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the ADPL Payment Entry & Collection Tracking System with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application with TanStack Router setup, authentication guards, role-based routing (admin dashboard, user management, payment entry/batch, reports), and loading states for protected routes.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Access denied screen component displaying a shield alert icon and message explaining that admin permissions are required, with a button to navigate home.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for new users to set up their profile by entering their name; saves profile with default 'user' role and invalidates relevant queries on success.
Alert banner prompting authenticated users without a profile to complete setup; dismissible and opens ProfileSetupModal when clicked.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout with header, navigation (admin/user-specific), mobile menu, and logout functionality; displays ProfileSetupPrompt for users without profiles.
frontend/src/components/payments/BatchPa: Form component for batch payment entry showing selected invoices grouped by retailer, payment mode selection, amount input with validation, and conditional fields for cheque/online payment details.
frontend/src/components/payments/Invoice: Searchable invoice selection component with checkboxes for multi-select; displays invoices grouped by retailer with search by invoice number, retailer code, or name, and shows selected totals.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Dynamic form editor for multiple payment lines supporting cash, cheque, and online modes; allows adding/removing payment lines with mode-specific fields (cash amount, cheque details, or transfer details).
frontend/src/components/reports/ReportsF: A filter component for reports that allows filtering by date range, salesman, payment type, and payment mode. Converts HTML date inputs to bigint timestamps and provides dropdowns populated from invoice data.
frontend/src/components/reports/Retailer: Displays payment entries grouped by retailer code in a table format, showing payment details including date, invoices, type, mode, transaction info, and amounts with formatted currency and dates.
frontend/src/components/tables/InvoicesT: A paginated table component for displaying invoices with sortable ageing days column, status badges, and navigation to invoice details, payment history, and batch payment entry pages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Hook that fetches the current user's profile and role from the backend actor, providing loading states and admin status derived from the backend role query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing AuthClient creation, identity state, and login status throughout the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating invoices, payments, and user data through the backend actor, with automatic cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors, including primary, secondary, destructive, and chart colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Admin dashboard displaying key financial metrics (total outstanding, collection, excess, pending balance) with navigation cards to upload, invoices, and reports sections.
frontend/src/pages/admin/RawDataUploadPa: Invoice management page for admins to upload Excel files with invoice data, download templates, clear all data, and view/filter uploaded invoices with search functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/UserManagementP: User management page for admins to view all registered users and assign roles (admin/salesman) with confirmation dialogs for role changes.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page component that handles Internet Identity authentication with error handling, retry logic, and informational messages about admin access requirements.
frontend/src/pages/payments/BatchPayment: Batch payment entry page allowing selection of multiple invoices and recording payments via cheque or online modes with validation for required fields and transaction details.
frontend/src/pages/payments/EditPaymentE: Page component for editing existing payment entries with form fields for amount, payment mode (cash/cheque/bank transfer), and mode-specific details like transaction ID, cheque number, and dates with validation.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentEntry: Page component for creating new payment entries against invoices, supporting multiple payment lines with different modes (cash/cheque/online), calculating totals, and handling excess payments.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentHisto: Displays a table of all payment transactions for a specific retailer, showing date, invoice numbers, payment type/mode, amount, and reference details with admin edit capabilities.
frontend/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.t: Reports dashboard with filters for date range, salesman, payment type/mode, displaying summary statistics (total collected, excess, pending balance) and retailer-wise ledger with CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/types/payment.ts: TypeScript interface defining the PaymentLine structure with fields for payment mode, amounts, and mode-specific details (bank name, cheque number/date, transaction ID, transfer date).
frontend/src/utils/excel/parseInvoicesXl: Utility function to parse CSV/XLSX invoice files, validating required columns (Retailer Code, Name, Invoice Number/Date, Salesman, Balance Amount) and converting rows into Invoice objects.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportReportsT: Exports payment reports to CSV format with summary statistics and detailed payment entries, including mode-specific fields (cheque, bank transfer) and DSE names mapped from invoices.
frontend/src/utils/export/invoiceUploadT: Generates and downloads a CSV template file with headers for invoice bulk upload, including optional 'Ageing Days' column.
frontend/src/utils/filtering/invoiceFilt: Provides invoice filtering functionality based on retailer name, retailer code, invoice number, and salesman name with case-insensitive matching.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/ageingDays.t: Calculates and formats invoice ageing days by parsing various date formats and computing the difference from today.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/normalizeInv: Normalizes invoice status from various formats (string enum, variant object) into canonical string keys for consistent rendering.
frontend/src/utils/payments/paymentDates: Derives effective payment dates based on payment mode (bank transfer, cheque, or fallback) and provides conversion utilities between HTML date inputs and backend nanosecond timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/payments/paymentStatu: Calculates payment totals, remaining balance, and excess amounts from payment lines, and determines payment status (Fully Paid, Partially Paid, Excess Payment).
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup functions.
frontend/src/utils/validation/paymentEnt: Validates payment entry forms by checking payment type, line amounts, and mode-specific required fields (cheque number, bank name, transaction ID, dates).
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions for colors (using OKLCH), typography, animations, and design tokens for a shadcn/ui-style component system.
project_state.json: Project state tracking a fix for batch payment functionality where users cannot select multiple invoices for single RTGS or cheque payments. Contains two completed features for invoice selector and RTGS processing, plus three pending feature requests for cheque payments and backend verification.
